title: Into the Green Dark
project: Test cue for the Immersive 3.0 engine: a deep-Amazon adventure for a game or a film trailer
brief: a Hans Zimmer-like, breathtaking immersive orchestra with SFZ samples, ambience and SFX for an adventure deep in the Amazon rainforest, in rain, tense and with a twist at every step and every second
audience: a listener on headphones, a living-room 5.1 and a 7.1.4 room, and on a phone speaker; they know the genre and are waiting for the turn
purpose: a 97-second Amazon adventure cue in which a walker is followed through the rain forest and the story turns three times
point_of_view: the walker: the field is what they hear, so the footsteps are always the nearest sound and the orchestra is the dread they carry
job: make the forest a place before the first threat: the listener should hear that it is alive, then hear it stop
turn the story three times: the forest goes silent, the key moves up a minor third mid-chase, the canopy opens and the drums answer from all around
keep one voice in the open at the start (a flute) and add a layer every few bars so the weight is earned
end unresolved: D with no third, a second set of footsteps, a held breath
story: A walker enters the green dark. The forest is alive, then a twig breaks and everything stops. Something follows. The monkeys warn, the rain closes in, the walker runs. At the lowest point the key changes. The canopy opens, the light is beautiful and wrong: the drums are all around, and somebody is walking behind.

sections.name: canopy
sections.action: the walker steps into the green dark under a closed canopy
sections.music: one flute call over a D pedal in the basses; harp drops like water off leaves; footsteps begin at bar 5

sections.name: closing_in
sections.action: the path narrows; something is moving
sections.music: celli ostinato in eighths and a heartbeat in the timpani; at bar 13 beat 3 a twig breaks and the whole forest stops; a jaguar answers at bar 15

sections.name: the_watcher
sections.action: the walker is being tracked; monkeys warn; the storm arrives
sections.music: the trombones and tuba enter on a D braam; ostinato goes to sixteenths; horns call on the fifths; the walker begins to run at bar 23

sections.name: the_chase
sections.action: a run through the rain; the key changes up a minor third at bar 29; everything stops on beat 3 of bar 32
sections.music: tutti: ostinato in two layers, timpani, bass drum, brass stabs in a 3+3+2 grouping, the horn theme in D minor then in F minor

sections.name: the_clearing
sections.action: the canopy opens: light, a river, and a held breath
sections.music: horns on the theme in F major with chorus and harp, rain lighter; the room opens upward

sections.name: not_alone
sections.action: the drums answer from all around and a second set of footsteps comes from behind
sections.music: conga from two far sides in a 3+3+2 call and answer, the flute returns to the pentatonic and ends on C, a Dm9 chord without its third; one last timpani blow

motifs.name: icaro call
motifs.shape: D F G A then a long C: four rising pentatonic notes and a held flat seventh
motifs.returns: inverted at 14.6 s, as single notes in the silence, as nervous fragments in the watcher, as a high counter-line in the clearing, slower and unresolved at the end

motifs.name: hunter theme
motifs.shape: D, up a fifth to A, then D C Bb: a call that falls back
motifs.returns: in F minor at the twist (66.9 s), in F major at the reveal (75.8 s), once more as a quiet D minor echo (86 s)

pulse: steady eighths in the celli that become sixteenths; footsteps are the second pulse and break into a run

hits.sound: a twig breaks under the walker's foot, and everything stops
hits.why: the forest's sound cuts in the same beat

hits.sound: the low brass enters on D: the first sight of the hunter
hits.why: the watcher begins; weight, not volume

hits.sound: the full orchestra enters: the run
hits.why: a second braam over a bass drum and timpani

hits.sound: the key moves up a minor third at the loudest point
hits.why: the brass and strings change chords together and the thunder cracks one beat before
silence is the biggest sound in the piece, so it must be exact
horns in F major over chorus; the rain lighter

hits.sound: the last braam and a single timpani blow
hits.why: Dm9 without a third, so it cannot resolve

must_hear: the first twig snap at 30.7 s with nothing else sounding
the jaguar from behind on the right at 35.8 s
two beats of silence at 74.7 s
the drums from both sides at 90 s
mix_intent.executed_by: carry this block on the score as `mix_intent` and set the mix preset's lead_carve to {"enabled": true, "from_intent": true}: `hero` (a track name) becomes the part the beds yield to and `leave_free_hz` the band they yield in. Without that the block is read by listen.py only.

delivery.played_on: a headphone listener, a living-room 5.1, a 7.1.4 theatre, a phone speaker (mono), and a game engine that takes objects (adm_bw64) or a sound field (ambix)

references: in words, not a track: a low-brass-and-ostinato chase with a held breath before the reveal, the colour of a modern blockbuster underscore with natural rain over it
the silence at the snap is the biggest hit; the drums answering from behind are the last

immersive.why: the story is about what is around the walker: the forest is a dome, the threat moves through it, and the final twist is that the drums are on every side. A stereo mix can say it; a field can place it

movers.why: it closes from behind to the walker's left as the watcher builds
movers.path: starts behind on the left at 6 m, passes to 75 degrees left and 3.6 m by bar 24

movers.why: it keeps pace with the run: it crosses the front and falls away behind on the right
movers.path: left of the listener at 5 m, through the centre at 2.6 m on bar 29, behind right at 5.5 m by bar 31

movers.why: the twist: someone else is walking, and gets closer
movers.path: behind on the right at 9 m, moving round to 4.5 m during the last four bars

room_changes.why: the canopy opens: the ceiling goes and the tail falls away
the forest closes back in: a low ceiling and a nearer, darker tail

must_hear: the jaguar crossing the front during the chase
the drums on both sides at the end
the sky opening at the reveal
immersive.notes: the sheet records intent; the mix, space and instrument presets execute it. Keyframes, heights and room geometry are in presets/spaces/green_dark_room.json and the score; mono is rendered from the mix, not summed from the stereo master.

gate_reason: a build-hit-release cue with a long line (the horn theme) and structured silences: the cinematic profile, started strict
notes: Every field is a target someone can check. feel and avoid_feel are what listen.py tests earshot against; sections is the cue's arc in seconds, and its names are what a trajectory or a room change is anchored to; hits_at is what listen.py looks for in the onset list, and hits is the same moments with a reason and a kind (cut, motion or musical). spatial_staging is the room seen from above: each preset must match its own spot. immersive says whether the field is doing a job, what moves and why, and where the room changes (numbers live in the presets). mix_intent says what must be audible and what must stay free. Write in plain English: earshot reads the words.
